assumptions: BUG-01 (payload.bugs) is the only fix in scope: cmdAdd's repo.save() call was unwrapped, letting a StoreWriteError surface as a raw Node stack trace instead of the clean 'Error: <message>' stderr line and exit 1 that cmdDone/cmdRm already produce. Wrapped repo.save() in cmdAdd (bin/todo.js) in a try/catch matching the existing cmdDone/cmdRm pattern, and added a regression test in test/commands/add.test.js that makes the store directory+file read-only, retries add, and asserts a clean 'Error: could not save todo store: ...' line with no stack-trace frames.

BUG-02 and BUG-03 are not fixed by this scope: they cite bin/todo.js:53/85/66/98 (the done/rm index-parsing order) and lib/parse-index.js (the error-message catalog), which belong to the done/rm command behavior owned by other scopes (TASK-004/005/006), not TASK-003's add command. lib/parse-index.js is also outside this scope's allowed_file_substrate (bin/todo.js, test/commands/add.test.js only), so those two bugs are left for the scope(s) that own that substrate.
